scope: Static discovery + task construction + native in-memory static validation; no rollout outcome used.
counting_unit: One concrete entity + proposed operation sequence/rule interaction; repeated entities are disclosed and not counted as independent states.

airline.segment_status: No native Airline write method advances a flight to flying/landed/delayed/cancelled. Modifications replace references to already-visible flight instances.
airline.other_fields: Passenger-count change is backend enforced; baggage changes do not activate a downstream prohibition unless artificial add-then-remove goal is introduced; insurance has no post-booking mutation method. Membership cannot be changed by these tools.

retail.status_transitions: items -> pending (item modified); cancel -> cancelled; return -> return requested; exchange -> exchange requested. Payment and addresses preserve status.
retail.resource_dynamics: Gift-card debits/refunds affect available balance; tool balance checks enforce sufficiency. No autonomous processed/delivered transition.
retail.spelling: Policy literal pending (items modifed) differs from backend pending (item modified). Semantic action-linked lockout is clear; no exact-string policy loophole used.
